subject: Trial commitments and milestone map
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Noah Chen <noah@novascale.io>
Cc: Lisa Park <lisa.park@novascale.io>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed trial commitments

Hi Noah / Lisa —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before a formal kickoff: 

Summary of goals (from today's discovery):
- Improve retrieval-to-generation latency for customer-facing search answers (target p95 < 350ms)
- Reduce token cost on the 3 most common query templates by 30% without degrading relevance
- Validate model stability under daily peak load (up to 200 concurrent inference sessions)

Proposed POC scope and success criteria (please confirm):
1) Acceptance metrics: p95 latency < 350ms, mean relevance delta <= -0.03 vs your current baseline, and 99.9% inference success rate.
2) Duration: 6 weeks (kickoff -> final readout) with a mid-point readout after week 3.
3) Deliverables: weekly cadence notes, access to token-level cost breakdown, a final performance report with suggested optimizations.

Operational asks from NovaScale:
- A named point of contact for engineering and a Slack channel for rapid triage.
- Test dataset or representative query set (CSV) + sample traffic profile.
- Cloud role with limited access for Redwood SRE to spin up Dedicated test capacity (or we can run in-hosted mode).

Proposed kickoff window: week of Aug 2 — we recommend Tue Aug 3 or Thu Aug 5 for a 60-min kickoff (UTC-7 friendly).

Attached: draft POC success metrics workbook. Also linking a short mutual action plan we typically ask customers to sign so roles and timelines are explicitly captured.

If you confirm the acceptance metrics and kickoff window, I’ll loop in our CS lead to lock owners and share the detailed milestone map.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com
Tel: +1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed trial commitments

Thanks, Karthik — this is exactly the kind of clarity we need. A few notes and confirmations from our side: 

- Acceptance metrics: we can live with the latency and cost targets you proposed — we’ll validate relevance using our internal A/B harness.
- Duration: 6 weeks sounds right. We prefer a final readout in the first week of Sept (that aligns with internal reporting).
- Kickoff: Thu Aug 5 works better for our engineering lead (Lisa) — can we do 10:00 AM PT?

Operational notes:
- Owner: Lisa Park will be our technical lead (cc'd).
- Dataset: I will share a sanitized query set (expected by EOD Wed).
- Access: we prefer Redwood to run the POC on a Dedicated pool in our cloud account to mirror production network conditions. Our procurement will need a short SOW/statement of work for infra costs — can your team provide an estimate?

One constraint: procurement requires a signed mutual action plan before we allocate test account credentials. Can you send the MAP and a short SOW for infra?

Appreciate it — looking forward to the kickoff.
Noah

Head of Platform Engineering, NovaScale

Action items (owners):
- Monica Patel: own trial orchestration, weekly syncs, run the mid-point readout, and validate customer-reported relevance scores. Please prepare a draft runbook.

Thanks —
Karthik

Ack — happy to take point on orchestration. Quick draft of owners & milestones: 

Week 0 (prep, Aug 5 kickoff):
- Kickoff (60m): align scope, SLAs, communication channel
- Deliverable: signed MAP, sanitized dataset ingestion checklist, SRE onboarding ticket

Weeks 1–3 (ingest + baseline):
- Ingest dataset, run baseline model, capture token-level cost.
- Acceptance gate at end of week 3: mid-point readout (metrics vs baseline).

Weeks 4–6 (optimizations + load):
- Apply batching/quantization suggestions from Redwood Optimize, run peak-load validation.
- Final readout & recommended plan for rollout.

Evaluation responsibilities (owners):
- Relevance validation: NovaScale A/B harness (Lisa) + Monica to sample manual checks
- Latency/cost telemetry: Marcus to provision and monitor Dedicated pool
- Prefix/KV cache test: Monica to add synthetic concurrency test (10–200 concurrent sessions)

Attaching a first-pass POC success metrics workbook — sheets: acceptance_metrics, runbook, weekly_agenda.

I’ll prepare a short SOW for Marcus's infra numbers and send both the MAP and SOW to Noah once Marcus confirms.
